name: reboot-kept-clock
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile. A 2.0 U bolus from the pump's screen 45 minutes ago, then a stop and a reboot 30 minutes ago that kept the pump's clock (ArmInit and VersionInfo records, no clock change), resumed, and a 1.0 U bolus 10 minutes ago. Every record is dated right, but a reader that takes every ArmInit record as a reset, as TandemKit does, leaves out the 2.0 U bolus before it. Whether a reboot keeps the clock is not known; this is the case where it does.
